stem: In most developed countries, school attendance is ____ until the age of sixteen, and parents who ignore this rule face fines.
explain_zh: 法律規定必須上學、不上學還要罰錢，所以是 compulsory（義務的、強制的）。voluntary 與 optional 都是「自願、可選擇的」，意思正好相反；flexible 是「有彈性的」，和罰款的語氣不合。記住 compulsory education = 義務教育。

stem: The university has revised its ____ to include more practical courses that prepare students for the changing job market.
explain_zh: 學校「修訂」的、裡面裝著課程的東西是 curriculum（課程大綱、全部課程）。career 是職涯、certificate 是證書、campus 是校園，都不能用 include more courses 來修訂。記住 revise the curriculum = 修訂課程。

stem: Adult ____ programmes in rural areas have helped thousands of farmers read contracts and fill in official forms by themselves.
explain_zh: 能讀合約、填表格講的是「識字能力」literacy。literature 是文學作品、literal 是形容詞「字面上的」、literally 是副詞，詞性與語意都不合。同字根但意思差很多，要分清楚。

stem: Rising ____ fees have discouraged many working-class students from applying to private universities in the capital city.
explain_zh: 和 fees 連用、會讓學生念不起大學的是 tuition（學費）。tradition 是傳統、intuition 是直覺、institution 是機構，放進 ____ fees 都不成立。記住 tuition fees = 學費。

stem: More than two thousand students have ____ in the online language course since the university made it free last year.
explain_zh: 學生「報名、註冊」課程用 enrol in，所以選 enrolled。employed 是僱用、engaged 是從事或訂婚、enclosed 是隨函附上，都不能接 in the course 表示修課。記住 enrol in a course = 選修課程。

stem: Teachers agree that ____ matters more than natural talent, because students who keep practising usually outperform those who give up early.
explain_zh: 後面說「持續練習的人表現較好」，指的是學習動機 motivation。motion 是運動或動議、movement 是移動或運動風潮、emotion 是情緒，都無法解釋「肯不肯持續練習」。同字根字要看語境挑。

stem: Continuous ____ of student progress allows teachers to spot weaknesses early instead of relying on a single final examination.
explain_zh: 與 final examination 對比、用來評量學習狀況的是 assessment（評量）。assignment 是作業、argument 是爭論、adjustment 是調整，都不能說 continuous ____ of student progress。記住 continuous assessment = 持續性評量。

stem: She won a full ____ that covered her tuition and living costs for four years of study abroad.
explain_zh: 學生「贏得」並支付學費與生活費的是 scholarship（獎學金）。sponsorship 是企業贊助、membership 是會員資格、partnership 是合夥關係，都不會用 win a full ____ 來形容學生求學。

stem: Employers increasingly ask for a formal ____ in data analysis, even for positions that were once open to any graduate.
explain_zh: 雇主要求的正式資格證明是 qualification。quality 是品質、quantity 是數量、qualifier 是預賽或修飾語，都不能說 a formal ____ in data analysis。記住 qualification 指學經歷資格。

stem: Her ____ performance improved dramatically after she learned how to manage her time and take clearer notes in class.
explain_zh: 空格後面是名詞 performance，需要形容詞 academic（學業的）。academy 是學院（名詞）、academically 是副詞、academics 是學者或學術科目（名詞），詞性都不對。判斷詞性是這類題的關鍵。

stem: Students are advised to ____ their notes regularly rather than trying to memorise everything the night before the exam.
explain_zh: 複習筆記用 revise（複習、修訂）。rewind 是倒帶、reverse 是倒轉或逆轉、revive 是復甦，都不能拿來接 notes。英式英文裡 revise for an exam 就是「準備考試」。

stem: Studying at home requires strong self-____, because nobody will remind you to switch off your phone and open the textbook.
explain_zh: 沒人提醒仍能管好自己，靠的是 self-discipline（自律）。disciple 是門徒、description 是描述、decision 是決定，都無法組成 self- 開頭的複合字表達自我管理。

stem: Poor ____ at morning classes forced the college to introduce an electronic system that records when each student arrives.
explain_zh: 系統記錄學生幾點到校，處理的是出席率 attendance。attention 是注意力、attempt 是嘗試、attitude 是態度，都不會用電子報到系統來記錄。記住 attendance 指到課、出席。

stem: ____ feedback encourages learners to read each other's essays carefully and to explain clearly why a paragraph is confusing.
explain_zh: 同學互相看作文、給意見叫 peer feedback（同儕回饋）。pair 是一雙、peel 是果皮或削皮、peak 是頂峰，拼字相近但意思完全不同。記住 peer = 同輩、同儕。

stem: ____ training offers a practical alternative for teenagers who prefer learning a trade to sitting in academic classrooms.
explain_zh: 學一門手藝、和學術課堂對比的是 vocational training（職業訓練）。vocal 是聲音的、vocabulary 是字彙（名詞）、local 是當地的，都無法表達「職業導向」。

stem: The government promised to cut carbon ____ by half before 2035 by closing its remaining coal-fired power stations.
explain_zh: 關閉燃煤電廠是為了減少碳排放，carbon emissions 是固定搭配。omissions 是遺漏、admissions 是入學許可或承認、permissions 是許可，和 carbon 都搭不起來。

stem: ____ energy sources such as wind and solar now supply almost a third of the country's electricity.
explain_zh: 風力與太陽能屬於可再生能源 renewable energy。removable 是可移除的、remarkable 是了不起的、reliable 是可靠的，都無法說明「風和太陽」這個舉例。

stem: Marine ____ groups are campaigning to ban fishing in areas where coral reefs are recovering from bleaching.
explain_zh: 保護海洋生態的團體是 marine conservation groups（海洋保育團體）。conversation 是對話、construction 是建造、concentration 是專注或濃度，都與禁止捕魚的訴求無關。conservation 與 conversation 只差一個字母，要看清楚。

stem: Air ____ in the city centre reaches dangerous levels every winter, when cold air traps exhaust fumes near the ground.
explain_zh: 廢氣累積在地面造成的是空氣污染 air pollution。population 是人口、solution 是解決方法或溶液、publication 是出版品，都不會被 exhaust fumes 造成。pollution 與 population 常被混淆。

stem: Hunting has left the species ____, and fewer than four hundred individuals now survive in the wild.
explain_zh: 只剩不到四百隻，代表該物種瀕臨絕種 endangered。dangerous 是「危險的」，是指牠會傷害別人；daring 是大膽的、endless 是無止盡的，語意都不合。記住 endangered species = 瀕危物種。

stem: Many cafés now charge extra for ____ cups in order to persuade customers to bring their own containers.
explain_zh: 用完就丟的杯子是 disposable cups（免洗杯）。disposal 是名詞「處理」、dispensable 是「非必要的」、displaced 是「被迫遷離的」，詞性或語意都不合。

stem: A severe ____ lasting three summers dried up village wells and destroyed almost the entire wheat harvest.
explain_zh: 井水乾涸、作物枯死是乾旱 drought。draught 是氣流或生啤酒、drain 是排水管、flood 是洪水，洪水更不可能讓井水乾掉。drought 與 draught 拼字極像，要特別留意。

stem: Farmers are turning to ____ methods that protect the soil so that the land can still be farmed by future generations.
explain_zh: 能讓後代繼續耕作，說的是永續的 sustainable。sustained 是「持續不斷的」、substantial 是「大量的」、suspicious 是「可疑的」，都表達不出「不耗盡資源」的概念。

stem: Clearing forests for palm oil destroys the ____ of orangutans, leaving them without food or safe places to sleep.
explain_zh: 動物居住的自然環境是 habitat（棲地）。habit 是習慣、inhabitant 是居民（指人）、hibernation 是冬眠，都不會因為砍樹而被 destroy。字根相近但用法不同。

stem: Most household rubbish still ends up in a ____, where it may take centuries to break down.
explain_zh: 垃圾最後被送到掩埋場 landfill。landslide 是山崩、landmark 是地標、landscape 是景觀，都不是垃圾的去處。記住 end up in a landfill = 最後進了掩埋場。

stem: Chemicals leaking from the factory ____ the river, and local people were warned not to drink the water.
explain_zh: 化學物質外洩使河水受污染，用 contaminate（污染）。contain 是容納、continue 是繼續、contribute 是貢獻，都不能解釋「不要喝這水」的警告。

stem: Household water ____ rises sharply in summer, so the city council is offering discounts on efficient washing machines.
explain_zh: 家庭用水量是 water consumption。consumer 是消費者（人）、assumption 是假設、completion 是完成，都不能用 rises sharply in summer 來描述。記住 consumption = 消耗量。

stem: Removing a single predator can damage the whole ____, because the animals it once hunted multiply out of control.
explain_zh: 掠食者與獵物互相牽動的整體是 ecosystem（生態系）。economy 是經濟、ecotourism 是生態旅遊、epidemic 是流行病，都無法被「移除一隻掠食者」破壞。

stem: The wetland is famous for its ____, supporting more than six hundred species of plants, birds and insects.
explain_zh: 物種數量多樣，講的是生物多樣性 biodiversity。biography 是傳記、biology 是生物學這門學科、biotechnology 是生物科技，都不能用來形容濕地擁有六百種生物。

stem: Travelling by train instead of flying is one simple way to reduce your personal carbon ____.
explain_zh: 個人造成的碳排放總量叫 carbon footprint（碳足跡）。footstep 是腳步聲、fingerprint 是指紋、footpath 是人行小徑，都不能和 carbon 搭配。

stem: Researchers want to know how constant notifications ____ the ability of teenagers to concentrate on long reading tasks.
explain_zh: 空格前有主詞 notifications、後面接受詞，需要動詞 affect（影響）。effect 通常是名詞「影響」，efficient 與 effective 都是形容詞。記住口訣：affect 是動詞、effect 是名詞。

stem: A wearable ____ can now track your heart rate and warn you when the rhythm becomes irregular.
explain_zh: 穿戴在身上、能測心跳的是 device（裝置）。advice 是建議、devise 是動詞「設計」、division 是分割或部門，詞性或語意都不合。device（名詞）與 devise（動詞）常被搞混。

stem: Increasing ____ in factories has cut production costs, although it has also removed thousands of low-skilled jobs.
explain_zh: 工廠用機器取代人力叫 automation（自動化）。automobile 是汽車、autonomy 是自治權、authority 是權威或當局，都無法解釋「降低成本又減少工作」。

stem: The company rewards ____ employees who suggest new ways of solving problems that nobody else has noticed.
explain_zh: 空格修飾名詞 employees，要用形容詞 innovative（創新的）。innovation 是名詞、imaginary 是「虛構的」、informative 是「資訊豐富的」，都不符合「想出新方法」。

stem: Villages without reliable internet ____ find it almost impossible to use online banking or government services.
explain_zh: internet access 是「網路連線、使用權」的固定說法。assess 是動詞「評估」、excess 是過量、accent 是口音，都不能和 internet 連用表示能否上網。

stem: ____ intelligence is already used to translate documents, detect diseases and recommend films to millions of viewers.
explain_zh: artificial intelligence（人工智慧）是固定名詞組合。artistic 是「有藝術性的」、artificially 是副詞不能修飾名詞、official 是「官方的」，都不能組成這個專有說法。

stem: Before buying a second-hand laptop, check reviews to make sure the battery is ____ enough for long journeys.
explain_zh: 電池要「靠得住」用 reliable。reliant 是「依賴的」（be reliant on）、relative 是相對的或親戚、religious 是宗教的，語意都不合。reliable 與 reliant 同字根但意思相反方向。

stem: The new engine is far more ____ than the old one, using thirty percent less fuel for the same distance.
explain_zh: 用較少燃料跑同樣距離，強調「效率高」用 efficient。effective 是「有效果的」（做得到，但不談成本）、sufficient 是足夠的、deficient 是不足的，都無法表達省油。

stem: The library has scanned its oldest manuscripts so that ____ copies can be studied by researchers anywhere.
explain_zh: 掃描後產生的是數位副本 digital copies。digit 是數字（名詞）、dignity 是尊嚴、diligent 是勤奮的，詞性或語意都不對。

stem: Users worry about ____ when apps quietly collect location data and sell it to advertising companies.
explain_zh: 擔心個資被蒐集，講的是 privacy（隱私）這個名詞。private 是形容詞、priority 是優先順序、policy 是政策，放在 worry about 之後意思都不通。

stem: Engineers are laying cables to extend the mobile ____ into mountain areas that have never had a signal.
explain_zh: 手機收得到訊號靠的是 mobile network（行動網路）。framework 是架構、workshop 是工作坊、paperwork 是文書作業，都不能用 extend into mountain areas 來談訊號。

stem: Medical students practise difficult operations in a ____ environment before they are allowed to touch a real patient.
explain_zh: 與 real patient 對比的是虛擬環境 virtual environment。virtuous 是品德高尚的、visual 是視覺的、vital 是至關重要的，都無法和 real 形成對比。

stem: You must ____ the latest security software; otherwise hackers can easily read the files stored on your computer.
explain_zh: 安裝軟體用 install。instant 是形容詞「立即的」、instruct 是指導、insist 是堅持，都不能接 software 表示安裝。

stem: Video tapes became ____ within a decade, and today almost nobody owns a machine that can play them.
explain_zh: 沒人再用、被淘汰的東西是 obsolete（過時的）。absolute 是絕對的、obstacle 是障礙物（名詞）、obvious 是明顯的，都無法解釋「沒人有播放機」。

stem: Satellites ____ weather data to ground stations every few minutes, allowing forecasters to track storms in real time.
explain_zh: 把資料傳送出去用 transmit（傳輸）。transport 是運送實體物品、translate 是翻譯、transform 是徹底改變，資料傳輸只能用 transmit。

stem: Some children are extremely ____ to peanuts, and even a tiny amount can cause a life-threatening reaction.
explain_zh: 對食物過敏用 be sensitive to（對……敏感）。sensible 是「明智的」，講的是判斷力；sensitively 是副詞、senseless 是「無意義的」，都不能描述過敏反應。sensible 與 sensitive 是經典易混字。

stem: A balanced ____ that includes vegetables, whole grains and fish lowers the risk of heart disease considerably.
explain_zh: 包含蔬菜、全穀與魚的是飲食內容 diet。diary 是日記、dairy 是乳製品、dialect 是方言，都不能說 a balanced ____ that includes vegetables。這三個字拼法相近要小心。

stem: The most common ____ of the illness is a high fever that lasts for more than three days.
explain_zh: 生病時出現的高燒是症狀 symptom。system 是系統、sympathy 是同情、summary 是摘要，都不能用來指發燒。記住 symptom of an illness = 疾病症狀。

stem: Regular sleep strengthens the ____ system, helping the body fight off infections during the cold winter months.
explain_zh: 抵抗感染的是免疫系統 immune system。immature 是不成熟的、imitate 是動詞「模仿」、immediate 是立即的，都無法組成對抗感染的系統。

stem: Childhood ____ has doubled in twenty years, partly because children walk less and drink more sugary beverages.
explain_zh: 少走路又喝含糖飲料導致的是兒童肥胖 obesity。obedience 是服從、objective 是目標或客觀的、obscurity 是默默無聞，都與體重無關。

stem: Doctors should not ____ antibiotics for a common cold, because these drugs have no effect on viruses.
explain_zh: 醫生「開藥」用 prescribe。describe 是描述、subscribe 是訂閱、inscribe 是刻字，字根相同但意思差很遠。名詞 prescription 就是處方箋。

stem: Early ____ greatly improves the chances of recovery, so patients are urged to report unusual pain immediately.
explain_zh: 提高康復機率的是及早治療 early treatment。treaty 是條約、retirement 是退休、agreement 是協議，都與康復無關。treatment 與 treaty 拼字接近但語意不同。

stem: School canteens are required to offer ____ meals containing fresh vegetables rather than fried snacks and sweet drinks.
explain_zh: 修飾 meals 要用形容詞 nutritious（有營養的）。nutrition 是名詞「營養」，不能直接修飾名詞；delicious 只講好吃、suspicious 是可疑的，都不符合「取代油炸食物」的重點。

stem: Universities have hired more counsellors because ____ health problems among students rose sharply during the pandemic.
explain_zh: 與 health 搭配、需要輔導員處理的是 mental health（心理健康）。mentally 是副詞不能修飾名詞、manual 是手動的、normal 是正常的，都無法組成這個固定說法。

stem: Public health experts argue that ____ is cheaper than cure, since vaccines cost far less than hospital care.
explain_zh: 與 cure（治療）相對的是 prevention（預防），諺語 prevention is better than cure 也是這樣搭配。protection 是保護、provision 是提供、promotion 是推廣或升遷，都無法和 cure 形成對比。

stem: Smoking ____ is difficult to overcome, and most people need several attempts before they finally give up.
explain_zh: 戒不掉的是菸癮 addiction（成癮）。addition 是加法或增添、attraction 是吸引力、adoption 是採用或領養，都不需要 give up 好幾次。addiction 與 addition 只差一個字母。

stem: Millions of adults live with ____ back pain that lasts for years and limits what they can do at work.
explain_zh: 持續多年的疼痛是慢性的 chronic。chronicle 是編年史（名詞）、chronological 是「按時間順序的」、comic 是滑稽的，都不能形容 pain。chronic 的反義是 acute（急性的）。

stem: Simple rules of personal ____, such as washing hands before meals, prevent a surprising number of stomach infections.
explain_zh: 洗手講的是個人衛生 personal hygiene。height 是高度、heritage 是文化遺產、hierarchy 是階級制度，都無法解釋為什麼能減少腸胃感染。形容詞形是 hygienic。

stem: Most patients ____ fully within a fortnight, although a few continue to feel tired for several months.
explain_zh: 病人痊癒用 recover（康復）。recall 是回想或召回、recycle 是回收、recognize 是認出，都不能和 fully within a fortnight 一起描述病情。

stem: Reducing your daily salt ____ by a small amount can lower blood pressure within just a few weeks.
explain_zh: 每天吃進去的量是 intake（攝取量）。intact 是形容詞「完整無損的」、income 是收入、outbreak 是疫情爆發，都不能接在 salt 後面。記住 salt intake = 鹽分攝取量。

stem: Neighbours should be ____ about noise, especially late at night when other families are trying to sleep.
explain_zh: 體貼別人用 considerate（體貼的）。considerable 是「相當大量的」，講數量不是人品；considering 是介系詞「考慮到」、consideration 是名詞，詞性與語意都不合。這組字是常考陷阱。

stem: ____ populations keep growing as young people leave farming villages in search of better-paid factory work.
explain_zh: 年輕人離開農村進城，增加的是都市人口 urban populations。urgent 是緊急的、suburb 是名詞「郊區」不能直接修飾名詞、rural 是「鄉村的」意思正好相反。

stem: Income ____ has widened in many countries, with the richest tenth now earning more than the poorest half combined.
explain_zh: 貧富差距擴大是 income inequality（所得不平等）。unequal 是形容詞、equality 是「平等」意思相反、inability 是「無能力」，都不符合後半句的對比數據。

stem: Volunteers run a ____ centre where elderly residents can share meals and join free computer classes.
explain_zh: 社區活動中心是 community centre。commodity 是商品、committee 是委員會、communication 是溝通，都不能組成提供共餐與課程的場所名稱。

stem: The new law makes ____ on the grounds of age illegal when companies advertise or fill vacant posts.
explain_zh: 因年齡而差別待遇是 discrimination（歧視）。determination 是決心、distribution 是分配、destination 是目的地，都不會被法律以 on the grounds of age 禁止。

stem: Rural-to-urban ____ has emptied hundreds of villages, leaving only elderly residents behind in many mountain regions.
explain_zh: 人口由鄉村移往都市的現象是 migration（遷徙）。migrant 是「移居者」指人、imagination 是想像力、integration 是整合，都不能造成村莊人去樓空。

stem: The country's ____ system supports families who lose their income through illness, unemployment or the death of a parent.
explain_zh: 照顧弱勢家庭的制度是 welfare system（社會福利制度）。warfare 是戰爭行為、farewell 是道別、wealth 是財富，都不能組成這個制度名稱。welfare 與 warfare 只差兩個字母。

stem: Festivals help younger generations understand the ____ values that their grandparents once took completely for granted.
explain_zh: 修飾 values 要用形容詞 cultural（文化的）。culture 是名詞、agricultural 是「農業的」、cultivated 是「耕作過的、有教養的」，都不符合節慶與世代傳承的語境。

stem: The ____ rate has fallen steadily since the council installed street lighting and opened youth clubs in the area.
explain_zh: 裝路燈、開青少年中心是為了降低犯罪率 crime rate。criminal 指罪犯或形容詞「犯罪的」、crisis 是危機、credit 是信用，都無法組成 ____ rate 這個常見搭配。

stem: Free school meals were introduced to make sure that children living in ____ still receive one hot meal daily.
explain_zh: live in poverty 是「生活貧困」的固定說法。property 是財產、priority 是優先事項、purity 是純度，都不能解釋為什麼需要免費營養午餐。poverty 與 property 拼字相近。

stem: Local ____ have been criticised for failing to repair the damaged bridge before the rainy season began.
explain_zh: 負責修橋、會被批評的是地方政府當局 local authorities。authors 是作者、authorship 是著作權或作者身分、authentic 是形容詞「真正的」，詞性或語意都不合。

stem: Hundreds of people ____ every weekend to clean beaches, plant trees and repair paths in the national park.
explain_zh: 主詞 people 後面缺少動詞，volunteer 可當動詞「當志工、自願做」。voluntary 是形容詞、volunteering 是動名詞、voluntarily 是副詞，都不能單獨當本句的主要動詞。

stem: Elderly people who live alone often feel ____, especially when public transport to the town centre is poor.
explain_zh: 感到孤立無援用 feel isolated。insulated 是「有隔熱或隔音的」、isolation 是名詞不能接在 feel 後當形容詞用於此、idle 是「閒置的、懶散的」，語意不合。

stem: The ____ collects unwanted clothes and sells them cheaply to raise money for homeless shelters in the city.
explain_zh: 募款幫助遊民的組織是 charity（慈善機構）。chance 是機會、charge 是費用或指控、chapter 是章節，都不會 raise money for shelters。

stem: It is a local ____ to remove your shoes and bow slightly before entering somebody else's home.
explain_zh: 當地的習俗是 custom。customer 是顧客、costume 是戲服、customs 加了 s 變成「海關」，意思完全不同。單複數與拼字都要看清楚。

stem: A small diesel car is more ____ on long journeys, since it burns much less fuel per kilometre.
explain_zh: 強調「省錢、省油」用 economical。economic 是「經濟（層面）的」，談的是國家或產業；economy 是名詞、economics 是經濟學。記住 economical = 節省的。

stem: The country enjoyed rapid ____ growth for a decade before rising oil prices slowed its factories down.
explain_zh: economic growth（經濟成長）是固定搭配，指整體經濟。economical 是「省錢的」、economically 是副詞不能修飾名詞 growth、economist 是經濟學家。這組字要靠語境分辨。

stem: When ____ reaches double figures, families notice that their wages buy far less food than the year before.
explain_zh: 薪水買到的東西變少是通貨膨脹 inflation。inflammation 是發炎、information 是資訊、installation 是安裝，都不會讓 wages 的購買力下降。

stem: The government raised the minimum ____ so that full-time workers could afford rent in the capital.
explain_zh: minimum wage（基本工資）是固定說法。charge 是收費、fare 是車資、fee 是規費或學費，都不是勞工領的薪水。

stem: ____ rose sharply when the shipyard closed, leaving nearly two thousand skilled workers without a regular income.
explain_zh: 工廠關閉導致失業率上升，用 unemployment（失業）。employment 是就業，方向相反；employer 是雇主；deployment 是部署，語意都不合。字首 un- 是關鍵。

stem: Foreign ____ in the region increased after the government promised lower taxes and simpler customs procedures.
explain_zh: 降稅吸引的是外來投資 foreign investment。investigation 是調查、involvement 是參與、instalment 是分期付款，都不會因為減稅而增加。

stem: Many young couples cannot ____ to buy a flat in the city, so they rent for years instead.
explain_zh: 買不起用 cannot afford to。afraid 是形容詞、effort 是名詞、offer 是提供，放在 cannot 後面當動詞都不合。記住 afford 常與 can/cannot 連用。

stem: The company made a record ____ last year, and shareholders were paid the largest dividend in its history.
explain_zh: 公司賺的錢是 profit（利潤），make a profit 是固定搭配。profile 是側寫或簡介、prophet 是先知、progress 是進展，都不能配發股利。profit 與 prophet 發音相近要注意。

stem: Students on a tight ____ often cook at home rather than eating in restaurants near the campus.
explain_zh: on a tight budget 是「預算吃緊」的固定說法。bargain 是便宜貨、baggage 是行李、bucket 是水桶，都不能用 tight 修飾表示錢不夠。

stem: Strong ____ for electric vehicles has pushed up the price of the metals used inside their batteries.
explain_zh: 需求量大會推升價格，用 demand（需求），常搭配 demand for。command 是命令、remand 是還押、demanding 是形容詞「要求高的」，詞性或語意都不合。

stem: Tourists complain that the local ____ is difficult to exchange once they leave the country's main airports.
explain_zh: 可以兌換的是當地貨幣 currency。current 是形容詞「現在的」或名詞「水流」、currently 是副詞、urgency 是急迫性，都不能被 exchange。

stem: She took out a small ____ from the bank to pay for equipment when she started her bakery.
explain_zh: take out a loan 是「辦貸款」的固定說法，loan 是名詞。lend、borrow、own 都是動詞，不能接在冠詞 a 與形容詞 small 之後。

stem: Coffee remains the country's most valuable ____, earning more foreign money than tourism and mining combined.
explain_zh: 替國家賺外匯的出口商品是 export。expert 是專家、expose 是暴露、explore 是探索，後兩者是動詞，放在 most valuable 之後也不通。

stem: ____ confidence fell after the news, and shoppers postponed buying furniture, cars and other expensive items.
explain_zh: consumer confidence（消費者信心）是固定經濟名詞。consumption 是消耗量、consuming 與 consumed 是動詞變化形，都不能組成這個說法。

stem: Government ____ keep bus tickets cheap, so people on low incomes can still travel to work every day.
explain_zh: 政府補助讓票價便宜，用 subsidies（補助金）。substitutes 是替代品、supplements 是補充品或增刊、surpluses 是盈餘，都不能直接讓票價變低。

stem: ____ about the exam results, he checked his phone every few minutes throughout the whole afternoon.
explain_zh: 分詞構句開頭要用形容詞 anxious（焦慮的），be anxious about 是固定搭配。anxiety 是名詞、anxiously 是副詞、ambitious 是「有野心的」，都不符合不停看手機的心情。

stem: After months of practice she felt ____ enough to give her presentation without reading from her notes.
explain_zh: feel 後面接形容詞 confident（有自信的）。confidence 是名詞、confidential 是「機密的」、comfortable 是身體上的舒適，都無法表達「不看小抄也敢上台」。

stem: Older employees were ____ to use the new software, mainly because nobody had explained its advantages to them.
explain_zh: be reluctant to 是「不情願做某事」。reluctance 是名詞、relevant 是「相關的」、reliant 是「依賴的」，後面接 to 的用法與語意都不符。

stem: Passengers grew ____ as the delay stretched into a third hour with no explanation from the airline staff.
explain_zh: 人感到受挫、惱火用 -ed 形的 frustrated。frustrating 是形容事情令人挫折、fascinated 是著迷的、flattered 是感到受寵若驚，都不符合久候無人說明的情境。

stem: She wrote a short letter to say how ____ she was for the stranger who returned her wallet.
explain_zh: how 後面接形容詞，感謝用 grateful。gratitude 是名詞「感激」、graceful 是「優雅的」、greedy 是「貪心的」，詞性或語意都不合。be grateful for 是固定搭配。

stem: Despite the poor weather, the farmers remained ____ that the harvest would still be large enough to sell.
explain_zh: 天氣不好仍相信收成會好，是樂觀 optimistic。optional 是可選擇的、opposite 是相反的、obvious 是明顯的，都不能接 that 子句表達正面預期。

stem: He felt ____ when he realised he had called his new teacher by completely the wrong name.
explain_zh: 人覺得尷尬用 embarrassed；embarrassing 是形容那件事令人尷尬。embraced 是被擁抱、empowered 是被賦予力量，語意都不合。-ed 修飾人、-ing 修飾事。

stem: The manager was ____ when I explained the situation, and she allowed me to change my shift.
explain_zh: be 動詞後面要形容詞 sympathetic（有同情心的）。sympathy 是名詞、symbolic 是象徵性的、systematic 是有系統的，都不符合主管體諒員工的情境。

stem: Voters seemed ____ to the debate, and fewer than a third bothered to visit the polling station.
explain_zh: 投票率極低顯示選民漠不關心，be indifferent to 是「對……冷淡」。different 是不同的、indefinite 是無限期的、independent 是獨立的，都無法解釋沒人去投票。

stem: Residents were ____ by the constant noise from the building site, which started before seven every morning.
explain_zh: 人被吵到很煩用 annoyed；annoying 是形容噪音本身令人厭煩，但主詞是 residents。announced 是宣布、amused 是覺得有趣，語意不合。

stem: The children were so ____ about the science club that they arrived half an hour before it opened.
explain_zh: so 後面接形容詞 enthusiastic（熱衷的），be enthusiastic about 是固定搭配。enthusiasm 是名詞、enthusiastically 是副詞、ethical 是「合乎道德的」，都不適合。

stem: Fans were deeply ____ when the concert was cancelled just two days before it was due to start.
explain_zh: 人感到失望用 disappointed；disappointing 用來形容令人失望的事。disapproved 是不贊成、disappeared 是消失，語意都不合。再次提醒 -ed 修飾人的感受。

stem: Investors have become more ____ since the crash, preferring safe savings accounts to shares in new companies.
explain_zh: 改買安全的儲蓄帳戶表示變得謹慎 cautious。caution 是名詞、curious 是好奇的、conscious 是有意識的，都無法說明避開高風險股票的行為。

stem: Her parents were extremely ____ of her when she became the first in the family to graduate.
explain_zh: be proud of 是「以……為榮」。pride 是名詞、prouder 是比較級但句中沒有比較對象且有 extremely 修飾、prone 是「易於（發生壞事）的」，都不適合。

stem: City life has made him more ____ of opinions that differ sharply from the ones he grew up with.
explain_zh: 能接受不同意見是 tolerant（寬容的），be tolerant of 是固定搭配。tolerance 是名詞、talented 是有才華的、turbulent 是動盪的，語意都不合。

stem: Sales of electric bicycles rose ____ between 2015 and 2022, more than trebling in only seven years.
explain_zh: 修飾動詞 rose 要用副詞 dramatically（大幅地）。dramatic 是形容詞、drama 是名詞、dramatize 是動詞，詞性都不對。雅思圖表題常用 rise dramatically。

stem: The number of visitors climbed ____ over the whole period, with no sudden jumps or falls.
explain_zh: 句尾說沒有突然的起伏，代表穩定上升，副詞用 steadily。steady 是形容詞、sturdy 是「堅固的」、suddenly 與 no sudden jumps 互相矛盾。

stem: The report records a sharp ____ in newspaper sales, which have halved since smartphones became common.
explain_zh: 銷量腰斬是急遽下滑 a sharp decline。recline 是身體向後躺、incline 是傾斜或坡度、deny 是否認，都不能描述銷售數字。a decline in 是雅思圖表常用說法。

stem: Temperatures ____ widely in the desert, rising above forty degrees by day and falling near zero at night.
explain_zh: 忽高忽低用 fluctuate（波動）。flatter 是奉承、flourish 是繁盛、frustrate 是使受挫，都無法描述白天熱、晚上冷的變化。

stem: Scientists recorded a ____ rise in sea level of about three millimetres each year since 1993.
explain_zh: 修飾名詞 rise 要用形容詞 gradual（逐漸的）。graduate 是動詞或名詞、gradually 是副詞、grateful 是感激的，詞性或語意都不合。

stem: The city's population ____ between 1990 and 2020, growing from two million to just over four million.
explain_zh: 從兩百萬變成四百多萬是翻了一倍，用 doubled。halved 是減半、divided 是分割、dominated 是支配，都與數據方向不符。

stem: Electricity use reaches its ____ at about seven in the evening, when most families cook and switch on heaters.
explain_zh: 用電量最高點是 peak（高峰），reach its peak 是固定說法。peek 是偷看、pick 是挑選、pack 是打包，發音或拼字相近但意思不同。

stem: Unemployment remained ____ at around five percent for three years before the pandemic changed everything.
explain_zh: remain 後面接形容詞 stable（穩定的）。stability 是名詞、stale 是「不新鮮的」、sustainable 是「永續的」，都不能描述數字持平。remain stable 是圖表常用語。

stem: Waiting times in emergency departments have lengthened ____ since the hospital closed two of its wards.
explain_zh: 修飾動詞 have lengthened 要用副詞 significantly（顯著地）。significant 是形容詞、signature 是簽名、specifically 是「具體而言」，都不合。

stem: The rapid ____ of the airport has brought more flights but also far more noise for nearby villages.
explain_zh: 機場規模變大是 expansion（擴建、擴張）。expense 是費用、expedition 是探險隊、exposure 是曝光或暴露，都不會直接帶來更多航班。

stem: Planting native trees may ____ some of the damage caused by decades of intensive cattle farming.
explain_zh: 讓損害逆轉、恢復原狀用 reverse（扭轉）。revive 是使復甦但不接 damage、reserve 是預訂或保留、review 是檢討，語意都不合。reverse the damage 是常見搭配。

stem: There was only a ____ increase in rainfall last autumn, far too small to end the water shortage.
explain_zh: 修飾名詞 increase 要用形容詞 slight（輕微的）。slightly 是副詞、slide 是滑動、sight 是視力或景象，詞性與語意都不對。a slight increase 是圖表常用語。

stem: The overall ____ was upward, although figures for individual months moved up and down quite unpredictably.
explain_zh: 整體走勢是 trend（趨勢）。trendy 是形容詞「時髦的」、thread 是線或討論串、tread 是踩踏，都不能用 overall 與 upward 來描述。

stem: Glaciers continue to ____ every summer, and several small ones have already disappeared from the mountain range.
explain_zh: 冰河面積變小用 shrink（縮小）。shrug 是聳肩、sink 是下沉、shrine 是神龕，都不能描述冰河逐年消失。

stem: Cheap solar panels could ____ rural life, bringing light and refrigeration to villages far from any power line.
explain_zh: 徹底改變生活樣貌用 transform。transfer 是轉移、transplant 是移植、transaction 是交易（名詞），都不能接 rural life 表示全面改變。

stem: Long working hours have a negative ____ on family life, leaving parents too tired to talk to their children.
explain_zh: have a negative ____ on 中間要放名詞，用 effect（影響）。affect 是動詞、affection 是「情感、喜愛」、effective 是形容詞。口訣：affect 動詞、effect 名詞。

stem: One ____ of the drought was that food prices in the capital rose by almost forty percent.
explain_zh: One ____ of... 需要名詞，consequence 是「後果」。consequently 是副詞、sequence 是順序、conference 是會議，詞性或語意都不合。

stem: Heavy rain in the north ____ in serious flooding that forced thousands of families to leave their homes.
explain_zh: result in 是「導致」的固定用法，空格後有 in。caused、affected、produced 後面都直接接受詞，不能加 in。要記住 result in（導致）與 result from（起因於）方向相反。

stem: The invention of cheap printing ____ to a sudden rise in literacy across northern Europe.
explain_zh: 句子在講歷史，要用過去式 led，lead to 是「導致」。lead 與 leads 是現在式、leading 是現在分詞，時態或形式都不對。

stem: A small earthquake can ____ a landslide if the soil on the hillside is already soaked with rain.
explain_zh: 引發、觸發某事用 trigger。trace 是追溯、trap 是困住、trail 是小徑或尾隨，都不能表示「引起山崩」。

stem: The bridge was unsafe and was ____ closed to lorries until engineers had finished the repair work.
explain_zh: 前後是因果關係（不安全→封閉），要用 therefore（因此）。however、although、whereas 都表示對比或轉折，語意方向不對。

stem: Historians ____ the city's rapid decline to the collapse of the silk trade in the sixteenth century.
explain_zh: attribute A to B 是「把 A 歸因於 B」。contribute to 是「促成」但方向相反且不能接受詞 decline 再接 to、distribute 是分配、tribute 是名詞「致敬」。

stem: Burning fossil fuels in power stations ____ more to climate change than any other single human activity.
explain_zh: contribute to 是「造成、促成」，後面有 to 正好搭配。consumes、confirms、conducts 後面都不接 to 表示「促成」，語意也不合。

stem: The closure of the factory had a lasting ____ on the town, which never fully recovered its former prosperity.
explain_zh: have an impact on 是「對……有影響」。import 是進口、impulse 是衝動、implant 是植入物，都不能用在這個固定句型裡。

stem: Many of the region's problems ____ from a shortage of clean water rather than from a lack of money.
explain_zh: stem from 是「源自於」。stand 是站立、stick 是黏住（stick to 是堅持）、steam 是蒸氣，後面接 from 都不能表示起因。

stem: Fuel became scarce; ____, the price of almost every imported product doubled within a few months.
explain_zh: 分號後面要副詞連接結果，用 consequently（因此）。consequent 是形容詞、consequence 是名詞、conveniently 是「方便地」，詞性或語意都不合。

stem: Careless drivers are ____ for most of the accidents that happen on this narrow mountain road.
explain_zh: be responsible for 是「對……負責、造成」。response 是名詞、responsive 是「反應靈敏的」、respectable 是「體面的」，都不能接 for 表示肇因。

stem: Serious problems ____ when governments introduce new rules without explaining them clearly to the public.
explain_zh: 問題「產生、出現」用不及物動詞 arise。arouse 與 raise 都是及物動詞，後面必須接受詞；arrive 是抵達，不能用在 problems 上。

stem: ____ to the strike, all trains between the two cities were cancelled for the entire weekend.
explain_zh: owing to 等於 because of，是「由於」。owning 是「擁有」的動名詞、owed 是欠款的過去分詞、own 是動詞或形容詞，都不能組成這個片語。

stem: The shocking documentary ____ thousands of viewers to write to their representatives about factory farming.
explain_zh: prompt somebody to do 是「促使某人做某事」。promoted 是推廣或升遷、proposed 是提議、protested 是抗議，都不能接 somebody to do 表示促使。

stem: Before writing the essay, you should ____ the question carefully and decide exactly what the examiner wants.
explain_zh: should 後面要接原形動詞 analyse（分析）。analysis 是名詞、analyst 是分析師、analytical 是形容詞，詞性都不對。美式拼法寫作 analyze。

stem: The experiment was designed to ____ that plants grow faster when they receive a longer period of light.
explain_zh: 實驗要「證明」某個結論，用 demonstrate 並可接 that 子句。demonstration 是名詞、dominate 是支配、demolish 是拆除，都不能接 that 子句表示證明。

stem: The figures ____ that younger drivers are involved in far more accidents than those aged over fifty.
explain_zh: 數據「顯示」某事用 indicate，後接 that 子句。indicator 是名詞「指標」、indict 是起訴、dedicate 是奉獻，語意或詞性都不合。

stem: Researchers cannot simply ____ that the pattern found in one country applies everywhere else in the world.
explain_zh: 未經證實就認定用 assume（假定）。assure 是向某人保證（要接人）、resume 是恢復、consume 是消耗，都不能接 that 子句表示「想當然耳」。

stem: Students are asked to ____ two competing theories and explain which one the evidence supports more strongly.
explain_zh: 衡量、評估理論用 evaluate。evacuate 是疏散、elevate 是提升高度、evaluation 是名詞，放在 to 後面當原形動詞也不對。

stem: The chart below is used to ____ how household spending changed during the first year of the recession.
explain_zh: 用圖表「說明」某現象是 illustrate。illustration 是名詞、frustrate 是使受挫、illuminate 是照亮，都不能接 how 子句表示圖表說明。

stem: It is important to ____ your key terms early, because readers may understand them in different ways.
explain_zh: 為名詞下定義用 define。defend 是辯護、refine 是精煉或改良、confine 是限制，都不能解釋「避免讀者理解不同」。名詞是 definition。

stem: In the final paragraph you should ____ your main points without introducing any new evidence or examples.
explain_zh: should 後接原形動詞 summarise（總結）。summary 是名詞、surmise 是推測、supervise 是監督，詞性或語意都不合。美式拼法為 summarize。

stem: Scientists ____ that the ice sheet has lost more than two hundred billion tonnes of mass annually.
explain_zh: 科學家「估計」用動詞 estimate，後接 that 子句。estimation 是名詞、eliminate 是消除、intimate 是親密的，都不能當本句主要動詞表示估算。

stem: The team plans to ____ a survey of five thousand households before publishing any firm conclusions.
explain_zh: 做調查、執行研究用 conduct a survey。conductor 是指揮或車掌、conclude 是下結論、construct 是建造，都不能和 a survey 搭配。

stem: Interviews with former employees ____ that the safety warnings had been ignored for at least three years.
explain_zh: 揭露原本不為人知的事用 reveal。recall 是回想或召回、repeal 是廢除法令、relieve 是減輕，都不能接 that 子句表示揭露真相。

stem: Inspectors visit each school every four years to ____ the quality of teaching and the progress of pupils.
explain_zh: 評鑑教學品質用 assess（評估）。access 當動詞是「存取」、asset 是名詞「資產」、assist 是協助，語意都不合。assess 與 access 只差一個字母。

stem: The professor wanted to ____ that reading widely matters far more than memorising a list of definitions.
explain_zh: 強調某個重點用動詞 emphasise。emphasis 是名詞、empathise 是「有同理心」（接 with）、emphatic 是形容詞，詞性或語意都不合。

stem: Many English words ____ from Latin, which is why they look similar to words used in Spanish.
explain_zh: derive from 是「源自於」。deprive 是剝奪（deprive somebody of）、drive 是駕駛或驅使、derivative 是名詞或形容詞，都不能接 from 表示字源。

stem: The author does not say this directly, but the final sentence seems to ____ that the policy failed.
explain_zh: 沒有明說卻讓人推得出來，用 imply（暗示）。apply 是申請或應用、reply 是回覆、employ 是僱用，都不能接 that 子句表示言外之意。名詞是 implication。
